sentences.text: The genus is defined by a partial snout and lower jaw elements, including a second snout assigned to the group.
Pabwehshi possessed serrated, interlocking teeth in its snout that created a zig-zag cutting edge.
The genus Pabwehshi was named in 2001 by Jeffrey A. Wilson and his colleagues.
Fossils of Pabwehshi were discovered in the Vitakri and Pab formations in Balochistan, Pakistan.
Pabwehshi is an extinct genus of baurusuchine mesoeucrocodylian.
The parent group for Pabwehshi is Sebecosuchia.
Larsson and Sues (2007) found a close affinity between Pabwehshi and the family Peirosauridae within Sebecia.
The type species is P. pakistanensis, named in reference to Pakistan where the fossils were found.
Pabwehshi lived during the Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period.
The time range for Pabwehshi is estimated to be between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
